title.zh: 卷九 本紀第九: 章宗一
title.raw: 卷九 本紀第九: 章宗一 Volume 9 Annals 9: Zhangzong 1

sentences.zh: 章宗憲天光運仁文義武神聖英孝皇帝，諱璟，小字麻達葛，顯宗嫡子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhangzong, styled Manifest Heaven and Radiant Fortune, Humane and Civil and Righteous and Martial, Divine and Sagely and Heroic and Filial, taboo name Jing, childhood name Madage, was the legitimate son of Xianzong.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhangzong—styled Manifest Heaven and Radiant Fortune, humane in civil arts and righteous in martial, divine, sagely, heroic, and filial—with taboo name Jing and childhood name Madage, was Xianzong’s legitimate son.

sentences.zh: 母曰孝懿皇后徒單氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Xiaoyi of the Tushi clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Xiaoyi of the Tushi clan.

sentences.zh: 大定八年，世宗幸金蓮川，秋七月丙戌，次冰井，上生。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Dading, Shizong visited Golden Lotus River; in autumn, seventh month, on bingxu he halted at Bingjing, and the future emperor was born.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Dading, while Shizong was at Golden Lotus River, on bingxu in the seventh autumn month he halted at Bingjing and the future emperor was born.

sentences.zh: 翌日，世宗幸東宮，宴飲歡甚，語顯宗曰：「祖宗積慶而有今日，社稷之福也。

translations.literal: The next day Shizong visited the Eastern Palace, feasted with great joy, and said to Xianzong: “Our ancestors’ accumulated blessing has brought this day—it is the fortune of the altars of state.
translations.idiomatic: Next day Shizong came to the Eastern Palace, feasted with great joy, and told Xianzong: “Our ancestors’ blessing has brought us to this day—it is the realm’s good fortune.

sentences.zh: 」又謂司徒李石、樞密使紇石烈志寧等曰：「朕子雖多，皇后止有太子一人。

translations.literal: ” He also said to Minister-in-chief Li Shi, Military Affairs Commissioner Hegeshilie Zhining, and others: “Though I have many sons, the empress has borne only the crown prince one.
translations.idiomatic: ” He also told Minister-in-chief Li Shi, Military Affairs Commissioner Hegeshilie Zhining, and the rest: “I have many sons, but the empress has given me only the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 幸見嫡孫又生於麻達葛山，朕嘗喜其地衍而氣清，其以山名之。

translations.literal: Fortunate that a legitimate grandson is again born at Madage Mountain—I have always favored that place for its breadth and clear air; let him be named for the mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Fortunate that a legitimate grandson is born again at Madage Mountain—I have always loved that place for its breadth and clear air; name him for the mountain.

sentences.zh: 」群臣皆稱萬歲。

translations.literal: ” The ministers all cried “Ten thousand years!”
translations.idiomatic: ” The ministers all cried “Long live the emperor!”

sentences.zh: 十八年，封金源郡王。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was enfeoffed as Prince of Jinyuan commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was made Prince of Jinyuan commandery.

sentences.zh: 始習本朝語言小字，及漢字經書，以進士完顏匡、司經徐孝美等侍讀。

translations.literal: He began studying the dynasty’s spoken language and script, and Han-character classics, with jinshi Wanyan Kuang, classics steward Xu Xiaomei, and others as tutors.
translations.idiomatic: He began the dynasty’s tongue and script and the Han classics, with jinshi Wanyan Kuang, classics steward Xu Xiaomei, and others reading beside him.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，世宗東巡，顯宗守國，上奉表詣上京問安，仍請車駕還都，世宗嘉其意，賜敕書答諭。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Shizong toured east; Xianzong held the realm. He submitted a memorial to the Upper Capital to inquire after health and still asked that the imperial carriage return to the capital; Shizong praised his intent and granted a written reply.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, while Shizong toured east and Xianzong kept the realm, he sent a memorial to the Upper Capital to inquire after the emperor’s health and begged that the carriage return to the capital; Shizong praised his care and answered with an edict in his own hand.

sentences.zh: 二十五年三月，萬春節，複奉表朝賀。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, third month, at the Wan Spring Festival, he again submitted a congratulatory memorial.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, third month, at the Wan Spring Festival, he again sent a congratulatory memorial.

sentences.zh: 六月，顯宗崩，世宗遣滕王府長史鳷、禦院通進鸊來護視。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Xianzong died; Shizong sent Chief Steward Zhi of the Prince of Teng’s establishment and Palace Service Commissioner Pi to oversee the mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Xianzong died; Shizong sent Zhi, chief steward of the Prince of Teng’s house, and Pi, commissioner of the palace service, to oversee the rites.

sentences.zh: 十二月，進封原王，判大興府事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, he was advanced to Prince of Yuan and assigned metropolitan affairs of Daxing.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was promoted to Prince of Yuan and put in charge of Daxing metropolitan affairs.

sentences.zh: 入以國語謝，世宗喜，且為之感動，謂宰臣曰：「朕當命諸王習本朝語，惟原王語甚習，朕甚嘉之。

translations.literal: Entering to give thanks in the national language, Shizong was pleased and moved, and told the chief ministers: “I ought to command all princes to study our dynasty’s language; only the Prince of Yuan speaks it well—I greatly commend him.
translations.idiomatic: He entered to give thanks in the national tongue; Shizong was pleased and moved, and told the chief ministers: “I mean every prince to learn our tongue—only the Prince of Yuan speaks it well, and I greatly commend him.

sentences.zh: 」諭旨曰：「朕固知汝年幼，服制中未可付以職，然政事亦須學，京輦之任，姑試爾才，其勉力。

translations.literal: ” Instruction: “I know you are still young and in mourning should not yet be given office, yet you must learn state affairs—the capital commission is to test your talent for now; strive hard.
translations.idiomatic: ” He instructed him: “I know you are young and in mourning cannot yet hold full office, but you must learn how government works—the capital post is to try your talent; strive hard.

sentences.zh: 」二十六年四月，詔賜名璟。

translations.literal: ” In the twenty-sixth year, fourth month, an edict granted the name Jing.
translations.idiomatic: ” In the twenty-sixth year, fourth month, an edict granted him the name Jing.

sentences.zh: 五月，拜尚書右丞相。

translations.literal: Fifth month, he was appointed Right Chancellor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he was named Right Chancellor of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 世宗謂曰：「宮中有《輿地圖》，觀之可以具知天下遠近厄塞。

translations.literal: Shizong told him: “In the palace is the Atlas of the Realm; studying it you can fully know the realm’s distances and strategic passes.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong told him: “The palace holds the Atlas of the Realm; study it and you will know every distance and every pass.

sentences.zh: 」又謂宰臣曰：「朕所以置原王於近輔者，欲令親見朝廷議論，習知政事之體故也。

translations.literal: ” He also told the chief ministers: “The reason I placed the Prince of Yuan in close attendance is to let him witness court debate and learn the body of governance.
translations.idiomatic: ” He also told the chief ministers: “I set the Prince of Yuan close at hand so he may hear how the court argues and learn the shape of affairs.

sentences.zh: 」十一月，詔立為皇太孫，稱謝於慶和殿。

translations.literal: ” Eleventh month, edict to establish him as imperial grandson; he gave thanks at Qinghe Hall.
translations.idiomatic: ” In the eleventh month an edict made him imperial grandson; he gave thanks at Qinghe Hall.

sentences.zh: 世宗諭之曰：「爾年尚幼，以明德皇后嫡孫惟汝一人，試之以事，甚有可學之資。

translations.literal: Shizong instructed him: “You are still young; as sole legitimate grandson of Empress Mingde, I test you with affairs—you have much capacity to learn.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong instructed him: “You are still young; as Empress Mingde’s only legitimate grandson, I try you with office—you have the makings of a learner.

sentences.zh: 朕從正立汝為皇太孫，建立在朕，保守在汝，宜行正養德，勿近邪佞，事朕必盡忠孝，無失眾望，則惟汝嘉。

translations.literal: I establish you as imperial grandson by the straight path—the founding is mine, the keeping is yours. Cultivate virtue on the straight path, keep no company with flatterers, serve me with full loyalty and filial piety, lose not the people’s hope, and only then will you earn praise.
translations.idiomatic: I set you up as imperial grandson by right—the building is mine, the keeping is yours. Walk straight, grow your virtue, keep away from flatterers, serve me with full loyalty and filial piety, and do not lose the people’s hope; only then will you have my praise.

sentences.zh: 」二十七年三月，世宗禦大安殿，授皇太孫冊，赦中外。

translations.literal: ” In the twenty-seventh year, third month, Shizong presided at Da’an Hall, bestowed the imperial grandson’s patent, and proclaimed amnesty within and without.
translations.idiomatic: ” In the twenty-seventh year, third month, Shizong sat at Da’an Hall, invested him as imperial grandson, and proclaimed amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，謁謝太廟及山陵。

translations.literal: On dingsi he paid thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and the mountain tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he gave thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and the mountain tombs.

sentences.zh: 始受百官箋賀。

translations.literal: He first received the officials’ congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: He first received the officials’ congratulatory memorials.

sentences.zh: 二十八年十二月乙亥，世宗不豫，詔攝政，聽授五品以下官。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, twelfth month, on yihai Shizong fell ill; an edict ordered regency, with authority to appoint officials of fifth rank and below.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, twelfth month, on yihai Shizong fell ill; he was ordered to act as regent and might appoint officials of fifth rank and below.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，受「攝政之寶」。

translations.literal: On dinghai he received the “Seal of Regency.”
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he received the Seal of Regency.

sentences.zh: 二十九年春正月癸巳，世宗崩，即皇帝位於柩前。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, spring, first month, on guisi Shizong died; he ascended the throne before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, spring, first month, on guisi Shizong died; he took the throne before the coffin.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔中外。

translations.literal: On bingshen, edict to within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen an edict went out to the realm.

sentences.zh: 賜丙外官覃恩兩重，三品已上者一重，免今歲租稅，並自來懸欠系官等錢，鰥寡孤獨人絹一匹、米兩石。

translations.literal: Granted two ranks of grace to officials outside the capital, one rank to third rank and above; remitted this year’s taxes and grain; also long-outstanding government debts; widow, orphan, and solitary households one bolt of silk and two piculs of rice.
translations.idiomatic: Officials outside the capital received two ranks of grace, those of third rank and above one; this year’s taxes and grain were remitted, long-standing debts to the state forgiven, and widows, orphans, and the solitary given one bolt of silk and two piculs of rice each.

sentences.zh: 己亥，遷大行皇帝梓宮于大安殿。

translations.literal: On jihai the late emperor’s coffin was moved to Da’an Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the late emperor’s coffin was moved to Da’an Hall.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以皇太后命為令旨。

translations.literal: On guimao, by the empress dowager’s command he issued directives.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, by the empress dowager’s command, he issued directives.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以大理卿王元德等報哀于宋、高麗、夏。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Director of Justice Wang Yuande and others announced the mourning to Song, Goryeo, and Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Wang Yuande, director of justice, and others announced the mourning to Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，白虹貫日亙天。

translations.literal: On yimao a white rainbow pierced the sun across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao a white rainbow pierced the sun from horizon to horizon.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，參知政事宗浩罷。

translations.literal: On dingsi Participation Councillor Zong Hao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Participation Councillor Zong Hao was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 山東統軍裔以私過都城不赴哭臨，笞五十，降授彰化軍節度使。

translations.literal: Shandong military commissioner Yi, for passing the capital on private business without attending the mourning lament, was flogged fifty strokes and demoted to Zhanghua Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong military commissioner Yi, who passed the capital on private business without attending the mourning lament, was flogged fifty strokes and demoted to military commissioner of the Zhanghua Army.

sentences.zh: 戊午，名皇太后宮曰仁壽，設衛尉等官。

translations.literal: On wuwu the empress dowager’s palace was named Renshou, and Guards Commandant and other offices were established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the empress dowager’s palace was named Renshou, and the Guards Commandant and other offices were set up.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Second month, on the xinyou new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinyou new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，始聽政。

translations.literal: On guihai he first held court.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he first took up government.

sentences.zh: 追尊皇考為皇帝，尊母為皇太后。

translations.literal: Posthumously honored his father as emperor; elevated his mother as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: He posthumously honored his father as emperor and elevated his mother to empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命學士院進呈漢、唐便民事，及當今急務。

translations.literal: On jiazi he ordered the Hanlin Academy to present convenient policies from Han and Tang and urgent matters of the day.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he ordered the Hanlin Academy to present Han and Tang measures that had served the people well, and the urgent business of the day.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，白虹亙天。

translations.literal: On yichou a white rainbow spanned the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou a white rainbow spanned the sky.

sentences.zh: 敕登聞鼓院所以達冤枉，舊嘗鎖戶，其令開之。

translations.literal: He ordered the Petition Drum Court, which exists to convey injustice—the doors had long been locked—to open them.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the Petition Drum Court, meant to carry grievances to the throne, opened; its doors had long been locked shut.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，更仁壽宮名隆慶。

translations.literal: On wuchen Renshou Palace was renamed Longqing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Renshou Palace was renamed Longqing.

sentences.zh: 詔宮籍監戶舊系睿宗及大行皇帝、皇考之奴婢者，悉放為良。

translations.literal: Edict: palace-register bonded households formerly belonging to Ruizong, the late emperor, and his father were all released to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: An edict released to commoner status all palace-register bondservants once held by Ruizong, the late emperor, and his father.

sentences.zh: 己巳，敕御史台，自今監察令本台辟舉，任內不稱職亦從奏罷。

translations.literal: On jisi he ordered the Censorate: from now supervising censors were to be selected by the censorate itself; those unfit in office could also be impeached and removed on memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he ordered the Censorate: hereafter supervising censors were to be chosen by the censorate itself, and those who failed in office could be impeached and dismissed on memorial.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，增定百官俸。

translations.literal: On dingchou official salaries were increased and fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou official salaries were raised and set in order.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔有司稽考典故，許引用宋事。

translations.literal: On yiyou edict that the responsible offices examine precedents and were permitted to cite Song precedents.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou an edict told the ministries to search precedents and allowed them to cite Song examples.

sentences.zh: 是月，宋主內禪，子惇嗣立。

translations.literal: That month the Song ruler abdicated in favor of his son, Dun, who succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Song emperor abdicated to his son Dun, who took the throne.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰，朝于隆慶宮，是月凡五朝。

translations.literal: Third month, on renchen, audience at Longqing Palace; that month he held court five times there.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renchen, he held audience at Longqing Palace; that month he did so five times.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔以生辰為天壽節。

translations.literal: On jiyou, an edict made the imperial birthday the Heavenly Longevity Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou an edict established the emperor’s birthday as the Heavenly Longevity Festival.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，夏國遣使來吊。

translations.literal: On guichou, Western Xia sent envoys to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Western Xia sent envoys to mourn.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己巳，夏國遣使來祭。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on jisi, Western Xia sent envoys for the sacrifice rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jisi, Western Xia sent envoys for the offering rites.

sentences.zh: 辛未，宋遣使來弔祭。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Song sent envoys for condolences and sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Song sent envoys to mourn and offer sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，葬世宗光天興運文德武功聖明仁孝皇帝于興陵。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Emperor Shizong Guangtian Xingyun Wende Wugong Shengming Renxiao was buried at Xingling.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Emperor Shizong Guangtian Xingyun Wende Wugong Shengming Renxiao was interred at Xingling.

sentences.zh: 戊子，朝于隆慶宮。

translations.literal: On wuzi, audience at Longqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he held audience at Longqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 六月己丑朔，有司言：「律科舉人止知讀律，不知教化之原，必使通治《論語》、《孟子》，涵養器度。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon jichou, the relevant offices memorialized: 「Candidates in the law examination know only how to read statutes and do not know the root of teaching and transformation; they must be required to master the Analects and Mencius and cultivate their bearing.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, new moon on jichou: the relevant offices reported that law-examination candidates knew statutes but not the foundations of moral instruction, and urged that they master the Analects and Mencius and build character.

sentences.zh: 遇府、會試，委經義試官出題別試，與本科通定去留為宜。

translations.literal: At prefectural and metropolitan examinations, let classical-meaning examiners set separate questions and test apart, and together with the main subject determine pass and fail—that is fitting.
translations.idiomatic: At prefectural and metropolitan trials, classical-meaning examiners should set separate papers; pass and fail should be decided jointly with the law stream.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」Approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」The throne agreed.

sentences.zh: 詔有司，請親王到任各給錢二十萬。

translations.literal: An edict to the relevant offices: at each prince’s taking office grant 200,000 cash.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that every prince receive 200,000 cash on taking up his post.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，修起居注完顏烏者、同知登聞檢院孫鐸皆上書諫罷圍獵，上納其言。

translations.literal: On xinmao, diarist Wanyan Wuzhe and Associate Director of the Petition Office Sun Duo both memorialized urging an end to encircling hunts; the emperor accepted their words.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the diarist Wanyan Wuzhe and Associate Director of the Petition Office Sun Duo both urged an end to encircling hunts; the emperor took their advice.

sentences.zh: 拾遺馬升上《儉德箴》。

translations.literal: Remonstrance Aide Ma Sheng submitted the “Admonition on Frugal Virtue.”
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance Aide Ma Sheng presented the “Admonition on Frugal Virtue.”

sentences.zh: 乙未，初置提刑司，分按九路，並兼勸農採訪事，屯田、鎮防諸軍皆屬焉。

translations.literal: On yiwei, the Judicial Inspection Commission was first established, to tour and review the nine circuits and also supervise agricultural encouragement and investigation; garrison farms and frontier-guard armies all came under it.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the Judicial Inspection Commission was created to inspect the nine circuits, promote farming, and investigate affairs; garrison farms and frontier armies were placed under it.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，幸慶壽寺。

translations.literal: On dingyou, he visited Qing Shou Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he went to Qing Shou Temple.

sentences.zh: 作瀘溝石橋。

translations.literal: The Lugou stone bridge was built.
translations.idiomatic: The stone bridge at Lugou was built.

sentences.zh: 己亥，朝于隆慶官。

translations.literal: On jihai, audience at Longqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he held audience at Longqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，罷送赦禮物錢，朝于隆慶官。

translations.literal: On jiachen, abolished the gift-money for amnesty delivery; audience at Longqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he ended the cash gifts sent with amnesty edicts and held audience at Longqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，高麗國王皓遣使來弔祭及會葬。

translations.literal: On yimao, King Hao of Goryeo sent envoys for condolences, sacrifice, and attendance at the burial.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao King Hao of Goryeo sent envoys to mourn, offer sacrifice, and attend the burial.

sentences.zh: 敕有司移報宋、高麗、夏，天壽節於九月一日來賀。

translations.literal: Ordered the relevant offices to notify Song, Goryeo, and Xia that the Heavenly Longevity Festival would be on the first day of the ninth month for congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Song, Goryeo, and Xia notified that congratulations for the Heavenly Longevity Festival were due on the first day of the ninth month.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命提刑官除後於便殿聽旨，每十月使副內一員入見議事，如止一員則令判官入見，其判官所掌煩劇可升同隨朝職任。

translations.literal: On dingsi, ordered that after judicial inspectors took office they receive instructions in the side hall; each year in the tenth month one of the chief and deputy commissioners should enter audience to discuss affairs; if there was only one, the deputy should enter; for the deputy’s heavy duties he might be promoted to the same standing as a court-attending post.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he ruled that new judicial inspectors hear instructions in the side hall; each tenth month one commissioner, or the deputy if there was only one, should enter audience on business, and a burdened deputy might be raised to court-attending rank.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉，減民地稅十之一，河東南、北路十之二，下田十之三。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on xinyou, reduced commoners’ land tax by one-tenth; eastern and southern Hebei routes by two-tenths; inferior fields by three-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinyou, land tax was cut one-tenth for commoners, two-tenths on the eastern and southern Hebei routes, and three-tenths on poor fields.

sentences.zh: 甲子，朝于隆慶宮。

translations.literal: On jiazi, audience at Longqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he held audience at Longqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，敕近侍官授外任三品、四品、賜金帶一，重幣有差。

translations.literal: On yichou, ordered that close attendants appointed to external posts of the third or fourth rank receive one gold belt, heavy silks in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he ordered that close attendants sent out at the third or fourth rank receive one gold belt and graded gifts of heavy silk.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以太尉、尚書令東平郡王徒單克甯為太傅，改封金源郡王。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Grand Guardian and Director of the Secretariat Tuodan Kening, Prince of Dongping, was made Grand Tutor and re-enfeoffed Prince of Jinyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Grand Guardian and Secretariat Director Tuodan Kening, Prince of Dongping, became Grand Tutor and was re-enfeoffed Prince of Jinyuan.

sentences.zh: 辛未，高麗遣使來賀即位。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Goryeo sent envoys to congratulate on the accession.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Goryeo sent envoys to congratulate him on taking the throne.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，奉皇太后幸壽安宮。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, escorted the empress dowager to Shou’an Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he escorted the empress dowager to Shou’an Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔京、府、節鎮、防禦州設學養士。

translations.literal: On xinsi, edict that the capital, prefectures, military commissions, and defense prefectures establish schools to nurture scholars.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi an edict required schools in the capital, prefectures, military commissions, and defense prefectures to train scholars.

sentences.zh: 初設經童科。

translations.literal: The Classics Youth examination category was first established.
translations.idiomatic: The Classics Youth examination stream was instituted.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫唐括貢罷。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Tangguo Gong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Tangguo Gong left office.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書移剌履為參知政事。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Yila Lü was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Yila Lü was appointed participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 以刑部尚書完顏守貞等為賀宋生日使。

translations.literal: Minister of Punishments Wanyan Shouzhen and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the imperial birthday.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Punishments Wanyan Shouzhen and others were sent as Song birthday envoys.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子朔，奉皇太后幸壽安宮。

translations.literal: Eighth month, new moon wuzi, escorted the empress dowager to Shou’an Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, new moon on wuzi: he escorted the empress dowager to Shou’an Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，敕有司，京、府、州、鎮設學校處，其長貳幕職內各以進士官提控其事，仍具入銜。

translations.literal: On xinmao, ordered the relevant offices: where schools were established in the capital, prefectures, states, and garrison-towns, among the chief, deputy, and staff each should have a jinshi graduate supervise the matter, and this should be entered in their title.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he ordered that wherever schools existed in capital, prefecture, state, or garrison, a jinshi among the chief, deputy, or staff should supervise instruction and carry the duty in his title.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，初定品官子孫試補令史格，及提刑部司所掌三十二條。

translations.literal: On renchen, first fixed the standards for sons and grandsons of ranked officials to test and fill clerk posts, and the thirty-two articles under the Judicial Inspection Commission’s jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen standards were set for ranked officials’ sons and grandsons to test into clerk posts, and thirty-two articles governing the Judicial Inspection Commission.

sentences.zh: 左司諫敦安民上疏論三事：曰崇節儉，去嗜欲，廣學問。

translations.literal: Left Remonstrance Dun Anmin memorialized on three matters: namely, esteem frugality, cast off indulgence, broaden learning.
translations.idiomatic: Left Remonstrance Dun Anmin memorialized on three points: cherish frugality, shed excess desire, and widen learning.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，如大房山。

translations.literal: On dingyou, went to Mount Dafang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he went to Mount Dafang.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，謁奠諸陵。

translations.literal: On wuxu, offered sacrifice at the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he offered sacrifice at the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 己亥，還都。

translations.literal: On jihai, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚子，朝于隆慶宮，是月凡三朝。

translations.literal: On gengzi, audience at Longqing Palace; three audiences this month in all.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he held audience at Longqing Palace—three times that month in all.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，制提刑司設女直、契丹、漢兒知法各一人。

translations.literal: On renyin, regulation: the Judicial Inspection Commission shall have one Jurchen, one Khitan, and one Han who know law each.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin a rule fixed one Jurchen, one Khitan, and one Han versed in law for each Judicial Inspection Commission.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，參知政事劉瑋罷。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Participation Councillor Liu Wei was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Participation Councillor Liu Wei left office.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀天壽節。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate on the Heavenly Longevity Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen congratulatory envoys for the Heavenly Longevity Festival came from Song, Goryeo, and Xia.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午朔，天壽節，以世宗喪，不受朝。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon wuwu, Heavenly Longevity Festival; because of Shizong’s mourning, no court was held.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, new moon on wuwu: Heavenly Longevity Festival, but with Shizong still in mourning the throne did not hold court.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔增守山陵為二十丁，給地十頃。

translations.literal: On gengshen, edict increased tomb guards to twenty ding and granted ten qing of land.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen an edict raised tomb guards to twenty households and granted ten qing of land.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔罷告捕亂言人賞。

translations.literal: On renxu, edict abolished rewards for reporting seditious talk.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu an edict ended bounties for denouncing seditious speech.

sentences.zh: 甲子，制諸盜賊聚集至十人，或騎五人以上，所屬移捕盜官捕之，仍遞言省部，三十人以上聞奏，違者杖百。

translations.literal: On jiazi, regulation: whenever bandits gather to ten persons, or mounted to five or more, the local office shall move the bandit-capture official to seize them and report in turn to the central ministries; thirty or more—memorialize the throne; violators—one hundred blows.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi a rule required that bands of ten thieves, or five or more mounted, be seized by the local bandit-capture office and reported up the ministries; thirty or more were to be memorialized to the throne; defiance earned a hundred strokes.

sentences.zh: 是日，朝于隆慶宮。

translations.literal: That day, audience at Longqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: That day he held audience at Longqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 是月凡四朝。

translations.literal: Four audiences at court this month in all.
translations.idiomatic: He held court four times that month in all.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，制強族大姓不得與所屬官吏交往，違者有罪。

translations.literal: On dingmao, regulation: powerful clans and great surnames must not associate with subordinate officials; violators are guilty.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao a rule forbade powerful clans and great lineages to deal with the officials under them; offenders were punishable.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以隆慶宮衛尉把思忠為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Longqing Palace Commandant of the Guard Basizhong was made Western Xia birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Basizhong, commandant of the guard at Longqing Palace, was sent as Western Xia birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以尚輦局使崇德為橫賜高麗使。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Imperial Carriage Bureau commissioner Chongde was made lateral-bestowal envoy to Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Chongde, commissioner of the Imperial Carriage Bureau, was named lateral-bestowal envoy to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 丙子，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: On bingzi, he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，監察御史焦旭劾奏太傅克甯、右丞相襄不應請車駕田獵，上曰：「此小事，不須治之。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Investigating Censor Jiao Xu impeached Grand Tutor Kening and Right Chancellor Xiang for failing to remonstrate against the imperial field hunt. The emperor said: “This is a minor matter and need not be pursued.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Investigating Censor Jiao Xu charged Grand Tutor Kening and Right Chancellor Xiang with failing to remonstrate against the emperor’s hunt. The emperor said: “This is a small matter—do not press it.

sentences.zh: 」乙酉，如大房山。

translations.literal: ” On yiyou he went to Mount Dafang.
translations.idiomatic: ” On yiyou he went to Mount Dafang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥朔，謁奠諸陵。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, new moon on dinghai: he performed obeisance and offerings at the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, new moon on dinghai, he paid obeisance and made offerings at the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 己丑，還都。

translations.literal: On jichou, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，朝于隆慶宮，是月凡四朝。

translations.literal: On gengyin he held court at Longqing Palace; that month he did so four times.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he attended court at Longqing Palace—four times that month.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上顧謂宰臣曰：「翰林闕人。

translations.literal: On xinmao the emperor turned to the chief ministers and said: “The Hanlin is short of men.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the emperor told the chief ministers: “The Hanlin lacks staff.

sentences.zh: 」平章政事汝霖對曰：「鳳翔治中郝俁可。

translations.literal: ” Grand Councillor Rulin replied: “Hao Yi, administrative supervisor of Fengxiang, would do.
translations.idiomatic: ” Grand Councillor Rulin answered: “Hao Yi, administrative supervisor of Fengxiang, would serve.

sentences.zh: 」汝霖諫止田獵，詔答曰：「卿能每事如此，朕複何憂？

translations.literal: ” Rulin had remonstrated against the field hunt, and an edict answered him: “If you can be thus on every matter, what have I to worry about?
translations.idiomatic: ” Rulin had urged an end to the hunt; the edict replied: “If you treat every affair this way, what have I to fear?

sentences.zh: 然時異事殊，得中為當。

translations.literal: Yet times and affairs differ; hitting the mean is what counts.
translations.idiomatic: But times and tasks change—the right course is the middle way.

sentences.zh: 」丙申，冬獵。

translations.literal: ” On bingshen, winter hunt.
translations.idiomatic: ” On bingshen the winter hunt began.

sentences.zh: 己亥，次羅山。

translations.literal: On jihai, he halted at Mount Luo.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he encamped at Mount Luo.

sentences.zh: 庚子，次玉田。

translations.literal: On gengzi, he halted at Yutian.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he encamped at Yutian.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，沁州、丹州進嘉禾。

translations.literal: On xinchou Qinzhou and Danzhou presented auspicious grain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Qinzhou and Danzhou presented stalks of auspicious grain.

sentences.zh: 丁未，次寶坻。

translations.literal: On dingwei, he halted at Baodi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he encamped at Baodi.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，中侍石抹阿古誤帶刀入禁門，罪應死，詔杖八十。

translations.literal: On gengxu Palace Attendant Shimo Agu mistakenly entered the forbidden gate wearing a sword; the crime warranted death, but an edict ordered eighty strokes of the staff.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Palace Attendant Shimo Agu, sword at his belt, wrongly entered the forbidden gate—a capital offense; an edict commuted it to eighty blows of the staff.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，至自寶坻。

translations.literal: On guichou, he returned from Baodi.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he returned from Baodi.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未，朝于隆慶宮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiwei, court at Longqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiwei, he held court at Longqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以右宣徽院使裴滿余慶等為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Right Xuanhui Court commissioner Peiman Yuqing and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Peiman Yuqing, commissioner of the Right Xuanhui Court, and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on the new year.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上謂宰臣曰：「今之用人，太拘資歷。

translations.literal: On guihai the emperor told the chief ministers: “Today’s appointments are too tied to seniority in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he told the chief ministers: “Appointments now cling too tightly to seniority.

sentences.zh: 循資之法，起于唐代，如此何以得人？

translations.literal: The progression-by-rank method began in Tang times—how can we get the right men this way?
translations.idiomatic: Step-by-step promotion began in Tang—how can talent be found that way?

sentences.zh: 」平章政事汝霖對曰：「不拘資格，所以待非常之材。

translations.literal: ” Grand Councillor Rulin replied: “Disregarding formal qualification is how one employs extraordinary talent.
translations.idiomatic: ” Rulin replied: “Waiving formal qualification is how one seats extraordinary men.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「崔祐甫為相，未逾年薦八百人，豈皆非常之材歟？

translations.literal: ” The emperor said: “When Cui Youfu was chancellor he recommended eight hundred men in less than a year—were they all extraordinary?
translations.idiomatic: ” The emperor said: “Cui Youfu as chancellor recommended eight hundred men in under a year—were they all extraordinary?

sentences.zh: 」甲子，諭尚書省曰：「太傅年高，每趨朝而又赴省，恐不易。

translations.literal: ” On jiazi he instructed the Department of State Affairs: “The Grand Tutor is advanced in years; to hurry to court and also attend the ministry is surely hard on him.
translations.idiomatic: ” On jiazi he directed the Department of State Affairs: “The Grand Tutor is old; rushing to court and also to the ministry must be taxing.

sentences.zh: 自今旬休外，四日一居休，庶得調攝。

translations.literal: Henceforth, apart from the decad rest days, let him rest one day in four at home, so he may recover his strength.
translations.idiomatic: From now on, besides the decad rest, let him stay home one day in four to recuperate.

sentences.zh: 常事他相理問，惟大事白之可也。

translations.literal: Routine matters other councillors may handle; only great affairs need be reported to him.
translations.idiomatic: Other councillors may decide routine business; only major matters need reach him.

sentences.zh: 」戊辰，諭尚書省，自今五品以上官各舉所知，歲限所舉之數，如不舉者坐以蔽賢之罪。

translations.literal: ” On wuchen he told the Department of State Affairs that from now fifth-rank officials and above should each recommend men they know, with an annual quota; failure to recommend would incur the crime of concealing talent.
translations.idiomatic: ” On wuchen he ordered the Department of State Affairs: fifth-rank officials and above must each recommend known talent within an annual quota, or face the charge of hiding able men.

sentences.zh: 仍依唐制，內五品以上官到任即舉自代，並從提刑司採訪之。

translations.literal: Following Tang practice, inner-court officials of fifth rank and above on taking office should at once recommend their own successors; the circuit intendants were also to seek them out.
translations.idiomatic: As under Tang, capital officials of fifth rank and above on assuming post should immediately nominate successors, and circuit intendants were to search them out as well.

sentences.zh: 己巳，初制轉遞文字法。

translations.literal: On jisi the regulations on relayed transfer documents were first enacted.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi regulations for relayed transfer documents were first promulgated.

sentences.zh: 壬申，朝于隆慶宮。

translations.literal: On renshen, court at Longqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he held court at Longqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命參知政事移剌履提控刊修《遼史》。

translations.literal: On yihai Participation Councillor Yelü Lü was ordered to supervise compilation and revision of the History of Liao.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Participation Councillor Yelü Lü was put in charge of compiling and revising the History of Liao.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以西上閣門使移剌邴為高麗生日使。

translations.literal: On dingchou Western Upper Gate commissioner Yelü Bing was made Goryeo birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Yelü Bing, Western Upper Gate commissioner, was named Goryeo birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 御史台奏：「故事，台官不得與人相見。

translations.literal: The Censorate reported: “By precedent, censorate officers may not meet with others.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate memorialized: “By precedent censors may not receive visitors.

sentences.zh: 蓋為親王、宰執、形勢之家，恐有私徇。

translations.literal: This was lest princes, chief ministers, and powerful families obtain private favor.
translations.idiomatic: The rule guarded against princes, chief ministers, and powerful houses winning private favor.

sentences.zh: 然無以訪知民間利病、官吏善惡。

translations.literal: Yet there was no means to learn of popular grievances or officials’ merits and faults.
translations.idiomatic: Yet they could not learn the people’s hardships or officials’ conduct.

sentences.zh: 」詔自今許與四品以下官相見，三品以上如故。

translations.literal: ” An edict ruled that from now they might meet officials of fourth rank and below; toward third rank and above the old rule held.
translations.idiomatic: ” An edict allowed meetings with officials of fourth rank and below; toward third rank and above the old ban remained.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔有司，今後諸處或有饑饉，令總管、節度使或提刑司先行賑貸或賑濟，然後言上。

translations.literal: On xinsi an edict to the offices: wherever famine might occur hereafter, circuit administrators, military governors, or circuit intendants should first extend relief loans or famine relief, then report upward.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi an edict charged the ministries: wherever famine struck, route administrators, military governors, or circuit intendants should lend or distribute relief first, then report up.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌朔，朝于隆慶宮，是月凡五朝。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on bingxu: court at Longqing Palace; that month he did so five times.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, new moon on bingxu: court at Longqing Palace—five times that month.

sentences.zh: 詔罷鑄錢。

translations.literal: An edict abolished coin casting.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ended coin casting.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，密州進白雉。

translations.literal: On dinghai Mizhou presented a white pheasant.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Mizhou presented a white pheasant.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，諭有司，女直人及百姓不得用網捕野物，及不得放群雕枉害物命，亦恐女直人廢射也。

translations.literal: On renchen he instructed the offices that Jurchens and commoners might not use nets to take wild game, nor release hawks in flocks to kill animals wantonly—for fear Jurchens would abandon archery.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he told the ministries that Jurchens and commoners must not hunt with nets or fly hawks in packs to waste game, lest Jurchens neglect the bow.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，複置北京、遼東鹽使司，仍罷西京、解鹽巡捕使。

translations.literal: On wuxu the Northern Capital and Liaodong salt commissioners were reestablished, and the Western Capital and Jie Salt patrol commissioners were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the Northern Capital and Liaodong salt commissions were restored and the Western Capital and Jie Salt patrol offices abolished.

sentences.zh: 以河東南、北路提刑司言，賑寧化、保德、嵐州饑，其流移複業，給複一年。

translations.literal: On report from the Hedong South and North route circuit intendants, famine relief was given in Ninghua, Baode, and Lanzhou; refugees who returned to their occupations received tax remission for one year.
translations.idiomatic: At the Hedong South and North circuit intendants’ report, Ninghua, Baode, and Lanzhou were relieved in famine; refugees who resumed farming received a one-year tax remission.

sentences.zh: 是日，禁宮中上直官及承應人毋得飲酒。

translations.literal: That day, drinking was forbidden to palace duty officers and attendants on active service.
translations.idiomatic: That day palace duty officers and resident attendants were forbidden to drink.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，祭奠興陵。

translations.literal: On yisi, offering at Xing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he made offerings at Xing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 壬子，諭台臣曰：「提刑司所舉劾多小過，行則失大體，不行則恐有所沮，其以此意諭之。

translations.literal: On renzi he instructed the censorate: “The circuit intendants’ impeachments are mostly petty faults; to proceed loses the larger pattern, not to proceed may discourage them—explain this meaning to them.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he told the censors: “Circuit intendants impeach mostly minor faults—acting harms the larger frame, inaction may chill them—convey this intent.

sentences.zh: 」甲寅，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀正旦。

translations.literal: ” On jiayin Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate the new year.
translations.idiomatic: ” On jiayin Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate the new year.

sentences.zh: 是冬，無雪。

translations.literal: That winter there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter brought no snow.

sentences.zh: 明昌元年春正月丙辰朔，改元。

translations.literal: First year of Mingchang, spring, first month, new moon on bingchen: the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: Spring, first month of the first year of Mingchang, new moon on bingchen: the reign title was changed.

sentences.zh: 以世宗喪，不受朝賀。

translations.literal: Because of mourning for Shizong, congratulatory audiences were not received.
translations.idiomatic: In mourning for Shizong, the court did not receive New Year congratulatory audiences.

sentences.zh: 上朝于隆慶宮，是月凡四朝。

translations.literal: The emperor attended court at Longqing Palace; that month he did so four times in all.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor attended court at Longqing Palace; that month he did so four times in all.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，制諸王任外路者許遊獵五日，過此禁之，仍令戒約人從，毋擾民。

translations.literal: On dingsi a regulation was issued: princes assigned to outer circuits might hunt for five days; beyond that it was forbidden, and their followers were still to be warned not to disturb the people.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the court ruled that princes posted to outer circuits might hunt for five days only; beyond that it was forbidden, and their followers were to be warned not to trouble the people.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，諭尚書省：「宰執所以總持國家，不得受人饋遺。

translations.literal: On xinyou he instructed the Secretariat: "Chancellors exist to oversee the state; they must not accept gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he instructed the Secretariat: "Chancellors exist to oversee the state; they must not accept gifts.

sentences.zh: 或遇生辰，受所獻毋過萬錢。

translations.literal: If on a birthday they receive offerings, the amount must not exceed ten thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: If on a birthday they receive offerings, the amount must not exceed ten thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 若緦大功以上親，及二品以上官，不禁。

translations.literal: For relatives within trimestral and greater mourning ties, and for officials of second rank and above, this is not prohibited.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以有司奏甯海州文登縣王震孝行，以嘗業進士，並試其文，特賜同進士出身，仍注教授一等職任。

translations.literal: On dingwei, because the relevant offices reported Wang Zhen of Wendeng County, Ninghai Prefecture, for filial conduct, and because he had once pursued the jinshi degree, his essays were also tested; he was specially granted status equal to a jinshi graduate and assigned a first-class professorship.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, because the relevant offices reported Wang Zhen of Wendeng County, Ninghai Prefecture, for filial conduct, and because he had once pursued the jinshi degree, his essays were also tested; he was specially granted status equal to a jinshi graduate and assigned a first-class professorship.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，至自萬甯宮。

translations.literal: On xinhai he returned from Wanning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he returned from Wanning Palace.

sentences.zh: 特賜胡光謙明昌二年進士第三甲及第，授將仕郎、太常寺奏禮郎。

translations.literal: Hu Guangqian was specially granted passing rank in the third cohort of Mingchang year 2 jinshi graduates and appointed court gentleman and Taichang Temple ritual presenter.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Guangqian was specially granted passing rank in the third cohort of Mingchang year 2 jinshi graduates and appointed court gentleman and Taichang Temple ritual presenter.

sentences.zh: 官制舊設是職，未嘗除人，以光謙德行才能，故特授之。

translations.literal: The bureaucracy had long provided this post but never filled it; because of Hu Guangqian’s virtue, conduct, and ability, he was specially appointed.
translations.idiomatic: The bureaucracy had long provided this post but never filled it; because of Hu Guangqian’s virtue, conduct, and ability, he was specially appointed.

sentences.zh: 己未，以烏林答願為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: On jiwei Ulinada Yuan was made left vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Ulinada Yuan was appointed left vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: On xinyou he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上謂宰臣曰：「朕欲任官，令久於其事。

translations.literal: On yichou the emperor told the chief ministers: "When I appoint officials I wish them to remain long in their duties.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the emperor told the chief ministers, "When I appoint officials I wish them to remain long in their duties.

sentences.zh: 若今日作禮官，明日司錢谷，雖間有異材，然事能悉辦者鮮矣！

translations.literal: If today one serves as a ritual officer and tomorrow manages money and grain, even if occasionally there is unusual talent, few can handle affairs thoroughly!"
translations.idiomatic: If today one serves as a ritual officer and tomorrow manages money and grain, even if occasionally there is unusual talent, few can handle affairs thoroughly!"

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「使中材之人久於其職，事既熟，終亦得力。

translations.literal: They replied: "Let men of middling talent remain long in their posts; once the work is familiar, in the end they too will be effective."
translations.idiomatic: They replied, "Let men of middling talent remain long in their posts; once the work is familiar, in the end they too will be effective."

sentences.zh: 」上問太常卿張暐：「古有三恪，今何無之？

translations.literal: The emperor asked Taichang Director Zhang Wei: "In antiquity there were the three Ke; why are there none now?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked Taichang Director Zhang Wei, "In antiquity there were the three Ke; why are there none now?"

sentences.zh: 」暐具典故以聞。

translations.literal: Zhang Wei set forth the precedents in full.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Wei set forth the precedents in full.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀天壽節。

translations.literal: On dinghai Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate the Heavenly Longevity Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai envoys from Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia arrived to congratulate the Heavenly Longevity Festival.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午朔，天壽節，以皇太后喪，不受朝。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on gengwu the new moon, the Heavenly Longevity Festival; because of the empress dowager’s mourning, audience was not received.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the gengwu new moon, the Heavenly Longevity Festival; because of the empress dowager’s mourning, audience was not received.

sentences.zh: 諭尚書省：「去歲山東、河北被災傷處所閣租稅及借貸錢粟，若便征之，恐貧民未蘇，俟豐收日以分數帶征可也。

translations.literal: He instructed the Secretariat: "Last year in disaster-struck places in Shandong and Hebei, withheld rent and tax and borrowed grain and cash—if collected at once, I fear the poor will not have recovered; wait until the harvest is abundant and collect by installments with the regular levy."
translations.idiomatic: He instructed the Secretariat, "In last year’s disaster areas in Shandong and Hebei, withheld rent and tax and borrowed grain and cash—if collected at once, I fear the poor will not have recovered; wait until the harvest is abundant and collect by installments with the regular levy."

sentences.zh: 」又諭宰臣曰：「隨路提刑司舊止察老病不任職及不堪親民者，如得其實，即改除他路。

translations.literal: He also instructed the chief ministers: "Along each circuit the Judicial Inspection Commission formerly only investigated officials who were aged and ill, unfit for office, or unfit to govern the people; if the facts were established, they were reassigned to other circuits.
translations.idiomatic: He also told the chief ministers, "Along each circuit the Judicial Inspection Commission used to investigate only officials who were old or ill, unfit for office, or unfit to govern the people; if the facts held, they were reassigned to other circuits.

sentences.zh: 若他路提刑司覆察得實，勿複注親民之職。

translations.literal: If another circuit's Judicial Inspection Commission on re-review finds the facts true, do not again assign them to posts that govern the people.
translations.idiomatic: If another circuit's Judicial Inspection Commission confirms it on review, do not assign them again to posts among the people.

sentences.zh: 卿等其議行之。

translations.literal: You ministers should deliberate and carry this out."
translations.idiomatic: Deliberate on this and put it into effect."

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，以郊社署令唐括合達為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Suburban Sacrifice Office director Tangguo Hedda was made Western Xia birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Tangguo Hedda, director of the Suburban Sacrifice Office, was sent as Western Xia birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 己卯，如秋山。

translations.literal: On jimao he went to Autumn Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he went to Autumn Mountain.

sentences.zh: 免圍場經過人戶今歲夏秋租稅之半，曾當差役者複一年。

translations.literal: Half of this year's spring-summer land tax for households through which the hunting enclosure passed was remitted; those who had performed corvée were given another year's exemption.
translations.idiomatic: Half of this year's spring-summer land tax was remitted for households the hunting enclosure passed through; those who had served corvée received another year's exemption.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，至自秋山。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on renyin, he returned from Autumn Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on renyin, he returned from Autumn Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丙午，敕御史台，提刑司自今保申廉能官，勿複有乞升品語。

translations.literal: On wuwu an edict to the Censorate: from now when the Judicial Inspection Commission certifies upright and capable officials, there must be no language begging advancement in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu an edict to the Censorate ruled that when the Judicial Inspection Commission from now certified upright and capable officials, the memorial must contain no plea for rank advancement.

sentences.zh: 壬子，有司奏增修曲阜宣聖廟畢，敕：「党懷英撰碑文，朕將親行釋奠之禮，其檢討典故以聞。

translations.literal: On renzi the relevant offices reported completion of enlarging and repairing the Confucius Temple at Qufu; edict: "Dang Huaiying shall compose the stele inscription; I will personally perform the libation sacrifice—review the precedents and report.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the relevant offices reported the enlarged and repaired Confucius Temple at Qufu complete; an edict said, "Let Dang Huaiying compose the stele inscription; I will personally perform the libation sacrifice—examine the precedents and report.

sentences.zh: 」甲寅，敕置常平倉處，並令州、府官以本職提舉，縣官兼管勾其事，以所糴多寡約量升降，以為永制。

translations.literal: On jiayin an edict: where ever-normal granaries are established, prefectural and circuit officials are to oversee them in their regular posts, county officials are concurrently to manage the affairs, promotions and demotions in rank to be gauged roughly by the amount of grain purchased—this to be the permanent rule.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin an edict ruled that wherever ever-normal granaries were set up, prefectural officials were to oversee them in their regular posts, county officials to manage the work, and promotions and demotions gauged roughly by how much grain was bought in—this as a permanent statute.

sentences.zh: 賜河南路提刑司所舉逸民游總同進士出身，以年老不樂仕進，授登仕郎，給正八品半俸終身。

translations.literal: You Zong of Henan Circuit, a reclusive scholar recommended by the Judicial Inspection Commission, was granted status equal to a jinshi graduate; because he was old and unwilling to seek office, he was given Gentleman for Initial Service, with half salary at the eighth rank for life.
translations.idiomatic: You Zong of Henan Circuit, a reclusive scholar whom the Judicial Inspection Commission recommended, was granted status equal to a jinshi graduate; being old and unwilling to take office, he was made Gentleman for Initial Service, with half salary at the eighth rank for life.

sentences.zh: 戊午，諭尚書省訪求博物多知之士。

translations.literal: On wuwu the Secretariat was instructed to seek men of broad learning and wide knowledge.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the Secretariat was ordered to seek men of wide learning and varied knowledge.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，遣諭諸王府傅尉曰：「朕分命諸王出鎮，蓋欲政事之暇，安便優逸，有以自適耳。

translations.literal: On guihai envoys were sent to instruct the tutors and commandants of the various princely establishments: "I have assigned the princes to posts in the circuits so that, in the leisure of government affairs, they may live at ease and find refreshment.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai envoys were sent to instruct the tutors and commandants of the princely establishments: "I have sent the princes to circuit posts so that, in the intervals of government, they may live at ease and find refreshment.

sentences.zh: 然慮其舉措之間或違於理，所以分置傅尉，使勸導彌縫，不入於過失而已。

translations.literal: Yet I fear that in their conduct they may at times stray from principle; therefore tutors and commandants were set beside them to guide and smooth matters so they do not fall into error.
translations.idiomatic: Yet I fear that in their conduct they may sometimes stray from what is right; therefore tutors and commandants were placed at their side to guide and smooth matters so they do not fall into fault.

sentences.zh: 若公餘遊宴不至過度，亦複何害。

translations.literal: If in their free time they feast and hunt without excess, what harm is there?
translations.idiomatic: If in time free of duty they feast or hunt without excess, what harm is there?

sentences.zh: 今聞爾等或用意太過，凡王門細碎之事無妨公道者，一一干與，贊助之道，豈當如是？

translations.literal: Now I hear that you sometimes go too far in zeal; every petty matter in a prince's household that does not impede public justice you take in hand—should support be like this?
translations.idiomatic: Now I hear that you sometimes go too far; every petty matter in a prince's household that does not touch public justice you take in hand—should aiding them be like this?

sentences.zh: 宜各思職分，事舉其中，無失禮體。

translations.literal: Each should reflect on his duty, keep affairs to the middle course, and not lose ritual propriety.
translations.idiomatic: Each should reflect on his duty, keep affairs to the mean, and not lose ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 仍就諭諸王，使知朕意。

translations.literal: Go also instruct the princes so they know my mind."
translations.idiomatic: Go also instruct the princes so they know my intent."

sentences.zh: 」丙寅，敕應保舉官及試中書判者委官覆察，言行相副者量與升除，隨朝及六品以上各隨所長用之。

translations.literal: On bingyin an edict: those who secure recommendations for office and those who pass the Secretariat examination shall have their conduct reviewed by officials; where words and deeds match, promote as appropriate; court attendants and those of the sixth rank and above each according to strength.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin an edict ruled that those securing recommendations for office and those who passed the Secretariat examination were to have their conduct reviewed by officials; where words and deeds matched, they were to be promoted as fit; court attendants and those of sixth rank and above were each to be used according to his strength.

sentences.zh: 己巳，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: On jisi he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午朔，尚書省奏：「翰林侍講學士党懷英舉孔子四十八代孫端甫，年德俱高，該通古學。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon on gengwu, Secretariat memorial: "Hanlin Lecturer Dang Huaiying recommends Kong Duanfu, forty-eighth-generation descendant of Confucius, aged and virtuous, thoroughly versed in antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the gengwu new moon, the Secretariat reported, "Hanlin Lecturer Dang Huaiying recommends Kong Duanfu, forty-eighth-generation descendant of Confucius, aged and virtuous, thoroughly versed in antiquity.

sentences.zh: 濟南府舉魏汝翼有文章德誼，苦學三十餘年，已四舉終場。

translations.literal: Jinan prefecture recommends Wei Ruyi for literary talent and moral repute, bitter study thirty years, four times completed the final round.
translations.idiomatic: Jinan Prefecture recommends Wei Ruyi for literary talent and moral repute, thirty years of bitter study, four times having completed the final round.

sentences.zh: 蔚州舉劉震亨學行俱優，嘗充舉首。

translations.literal: Weizhou recommends Liu Zhenheng, learning and conduct all excellent, once head of the examination cohort.
translations.idiomatic: Weizhou recommends Liu Zhenheng, whose learning and conduct are both excellent and who once headed the examination cohort.

sentences.zh: 益都府舉王樞博學善書，事親至孝。

translations.literal: Yidu prefecture recommends Wang Shu, erudite and skilled in calligraphy, filial in serving parents.
translations.idiomatic: Yidu Prefecture recommends Wang Shu, erudite and skilled in calligraphy, filial in serving his parents.

sentences.zh: 」敕魏汝翼特賜進士及第，劉震亨等同進士出身，並附王澤榜。

translations.literal: " Edict: Wei Ruyi specially granted Presented Scholar; Liu Zhenheng and others status equal to a jinshi graduate, all attached to Wang Ze's roster.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict granted Wei Ruyi the title Presented Scholar, Liu Zhenheng and others status equal to a jinshi graduate, all attached to Wang Ze's roster.

sentences.zh: 孔端甫俟春暖召之。

translations.literal: Kong Duanfu to be summoned when spring warms.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Duanfu was to be summoned when spring warmed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔臣庶名犯古帝王而姓複同者禁之，周公、孔子之名亦令回避。

translations.literal: On bingzi an edict forbade commoners from taking names that violate ancient emperors when the surname is also the same; names of the Duke of Zhou and Confucius must also be avoided.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi an edict forbade commoners from taking names that violated ancient emperors when the surname was also the same; the names of the Duke of Zhou and Confucius must also be avoided.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，升相州為彰德府。

translations.literal: On wuyin Xiangzhou was promoted to Zhangde Superior Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Xiangzhou was promoted to Zhangde Superior Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以前右副都點檢溫敦忠等為賀宋正旦使。

translations.idiomatic: Former Right Deputy Chief Inspector Wendun Zhong and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 壬午，尚書省奏：「知河南府事程嶧乞進封父祖。

translations.literal: On renwu the Secretariat memorialized: "Cheng Yi, administrator of Henan prefecture, requests advancement and enfeoffment for father and grandfather."
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the Secretariat reported, "Cheng Yi, administrator of Henan Prefecture, asks to advance and enfeoff his father and grandfather."

sentences.zh: 」權尚書禮部郎中党懷英言：「凡宰執改除外任長官，其佐官以下相見禮儀皆與他長官不同，其子亦得試補省令史。

translations.literal: Acting Director of the Ministry of Rites Dang Huaiying said: "Whenever chief executives are transferred to outer posts as chief administrators, the etiquette when their subordinate officials meet them differs from other chiefs; their sons may also test into provincial secretariat clerk posts.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Director of the Ministry of Rites Dang Huaiying said, "Whenever chief executives are transferred to outer posts as chief administrators, the etiquette when subordinate officials meet them differs from other chiefs; their sons may also test into provincial secretariat clerk posts.

sentences.zh: 其子且爾，父祖封贈理當不同，合舉宰執一例封贈。

translations.literal: If even their sons are so treated, enfeoffment of father and grandfather should differ—present a single rule for chief executives' enfeoffments."
translations.idiomatic: If even their sons are so treated, enfeoffment of father and grandfather should differ—set a single rule for chief executives' enfeoffments."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

translations.literal: On jiashen the title Judicial Inspection Commissioner was changed to clerk-scribe.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the title Judicial Inspection Commissioner was changed to clerk-scribe.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以有司言：「河州定羌民張顯孝友力田，焚券已責，又獻粟千石以賑饑。

translations.literal: On bingchen, because the relevant offices reported: "In Hezhou, Dingqiang commoner Zhang Xian was filial, friendly, and strong in farming, burned his debt slips after collection, and again presented a thousand piculs of grain to relieve famine.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, because the relevant offices reported, "In Hezhou, Dingqiang commoner Zhang Xian was filial, friendly, and strong in farming, burned his debt slips after collection, and again presented a thousand piculs of grain to relieve famine.

sentences.zh: 棣州民榮楫賑米七百石、錢三百貫，冬月散柴薪三千束。

translations.idiomatic: Dizhou commoner Rong Ji relieved famine with seven hundred piculs of grain and three hundred strings of cash, and in winter distributed three thousand bundles of firewood.

sentences.zh: 皆別無希覬。

translations.literal: Neither sought anything in return."
translations.idiomatic: Neither sought anything in return."

translations.literal: Each was specially given two rank advancements, still ranked in the regular roster.
translations.idiomatic: Each was specially advanced two ranks, still ranked in the regular sequence.

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on guimao Eastern Upper Inner Gate commissioner Zhang Yourou was made Goryeo birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guimao Zhang Yourou, Eastern Upper Inner Gate commissioner, was sent as Goryeo birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，諭有司祈雪。

translations.literal: On xinhai the relevant offices were instructed to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the relevant offices were ordered to pray for snow.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: On guichou he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，有赤氣見於北方。

translations.literal: On bingchen red vapor appeared in the north.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen red vapor appeared in the north.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，敕華州下邽縣置武定鎮倉，京兆櫟陽縣置粟邑鎮倉，許州舞陽縣置北舞渡倉，各設倉草都監一人，縣官兼領之。

translations.idiomatic: On dingsi an edict ordered Wuding Town Granary in Xiayi County, Hua Prefecture; Suyi Town Granary in Liyang County, Jingzhao; and Beiwudu Granary in Wuyang County, Xu Prefecture; each with one granary-forage overseer, led concurrently by the county official.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，定到任告致仕格。

translations.literal: On yichou regulations for reporting on taking office and for petitioning retirement were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou regulations for reporting on taking office and for petitioning retirement were fixed.

translations.idiomatic: On dingmao envoys from Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia arrived to congratulate New Year's Day.
